info.name: BMSDec24 API - Full Scenarios
info.description:
Comprehensive collection for all REST endpoints with positive, negative, edge, and corner-case scenarios.

Runner order:
1) Health
2) Users → Signup success (stores loginEmail + loginPassword)
3) Users → Signup duplicate
4) Auth → Login success (stores accessToken + refreshToken + signedUpUserId)
5) Auth → Login negatives, Refresh, Me
6) Security Edge Cases (calls to protected endpoints without/with bad tokens)
7) Tickets → Booking → Confirm/Cancel → Availability/Cleanup

Usage notes:
- Run db/seed_bmsdec24.sql once in MySQL Workbench to load deterministic data.
- All requests in Tickets/* and Auth → Me use collection-level Bearer auth via {{accessToken}}.
- Public endpoints (Health, Signup, Login, Refresh) override auth to noauth.
- Run Auth → Login success before Tickets requests to populate the bearer token.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Strategy-pattern payment flow. After booking seats (PENDING ticket) the user is directed here: initiate a payment with STRIPE or RAZORPAY, then the provider callback confirms (success) or cancels (failure) the booking. Run after Auth → Login success so the bearer token is set.

item.name: Setup: book seats for Stripe success (stores paymentTicketId)

request.description: Books fresh available seats so the Stripe payment flow has a PENDING ticket to operate on.
Simulates Stripe reporting a successful capture. The gateway verifies the signature, then the booking is confirmed.
Re-posting a callback for an already settled payment must be rejected.
Only PENDING tickets can be paid; initiating on a CONFIRMED ticket is rejected.

item.name: Setup: book seats for Razorpay failure (stores paymentTicketIdFail)

request.description: Simulates Razorpay reporting a failed payment. The booking is automatically cancelled and seats released.
